name: macrazer-reports
description: Receives MacRazer device test reports and emails them to the maintainer, and records opted-in usage stats.

scripts.check:local: npm run config && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.local.toml --outdir .wrangler/dry-run
scripts.migrate: npm run config && wrangler d1 migrations apply macrazer-reports --remote --config wrangler.local.toml
scripts.deploy: npm run config && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.local.toml
scripts.salt: npm run config && openssl rand -hex 32 | wrangler secret put IP_SALT --config wrangler.local.toml
scripts.tail: npm run config && wrangler tail --config wrangler.local.toml
